purpose: Hand-labelled alert -> expected-technique pairs. PLAN §4.4 requires retrieval quality to be MEASURED, not asserted. scripts/eval_retrieval.py scores recall@k against this file and writes models/index/RETRIEVAL_REPORT.json.
query_shape: Each pair carries the ALERT FIELDS, not a pre-built query string. scripts/eval_retrieval.py builds the query with app.rag.retriever.build_query, the same function Phase 3's retrieve node calls, so the measured recall@k describes the production path. `attack_type` is the CLASSIFIER's verdict, never the ground-truth label; the signature alone is deliberately label-free (PLAN I4) and too generic to retrieve on.
expected_semantics: `expected` lists every technique a security analyst would accept as correct for that alert. A hit on ANY of them counts. Listing one arbitrary 'right answer' when several are equally defensible would measure agreement with an arbitrary choice rather than retrieval quality.
